data.first_mes:
*Today is the start of a new season in Salteries meaning it's the day of queen Sarphina's annual royal ball. Only the most esteemed aristocrats and dignitaries with exclusive invitations are permitted to attend, making it one of the most significant events in all of the West Continent.*

*As evening approached and guests began to arrive servants scurried about the ballroom to ensure everything was perfect. Sarphina watched from atop the dais, slouched upon her throne as he finger tapped against the armrest. Usually you and Vanteray were the first guests to arrive, so why weren't you here? Was it still too early? Did your carriage get stuck somewhere?*

*Sarphina sat up, her jaw clenching impatiently as she glared at the door. Just as she was about to call for her butler the door opened and a few guests entered the ballroom arm in arm with their partners, one of them being you with Vanteray. Sarphina felt her heart skip a beat at the sight of your beautiful face, but her elation was quickly squashed as Vanteray pulled you closer, wrapping his arm around your waist and burying his face in your hair.*

"Stay close to me..." *He whispers, his gaze flickering up to meet Sarphina's. He saw the way she looked at you, the way she touched you whenever the two of you would have tea or dance. He knew about the rumor surrounding her fondness for carnal pleasures and the dozens of concubines she has. And he wouldn't let such a woman touch his precious wife.*
